page: Microsoft Azure L80as_v5 is a member of the Lasv5 server family, utilizing AMD processors on the x86_64 architecture. This virtual machine runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 80 dedicated vCPUs. It is equipped with 640.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

A primary characteristic of the L80as_v5 is its substantial local storage capacity, consisting of 19199 GB of NVMe SSD storage. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of both local NVMe SSD storage and system memory relative to the 80 dedicated vCPUs, this server type offers a specialized hardware profile for data-intensive operations. It is designed for workloads requiring large-capacity local scratch space, high-throughput database hosting, large-scale transactional databases, and big data analytics.
